newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks edge up to another year high close.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks edge up to another year high close.

text.p: South Korean stocks climbed for the third consecutive day on Saturday to close at another year high, brokers said.
The composite stock index stood at 791.97 at the close, up 2.82 points from Friday. Losers outpaced gainers by 522 to 264.
Brokers said the market rallied to a high of 798.89 in early morning, but lost steam as selling pressure at the 800 level set in.
"The market was strong in early morning, led by strong institutional buying in construction shares," said Baek Jung-hyun at Samsung Securities.
Brokers said relatively low priced construction shares continued to attract interest, particularly from institutions.
They said investors believed low interest rates would help boost earnings at the construction firms that heavily rely on borrowings.
Hyundai Engineering and Construction gained 1,800 won to end at a year high of 24,800, while Byucksan Engineering and Construction added 650 won to close at a daily limit high of 8,850.
However, selling on small- to mid-sized issues cooled investor sentiment preventing the index from rising above 800.
Brokers said the market was likely to rise above the psychological resistance of 800 next week despite expectations of brief consolidations.
Volume totalled 59.7 million shares in half trading on Saturday, compared with 83.6 million on Friday.
